user.title: Connect a Show SIP endpoint
user.description: Paste the reviewed endpoint JSON containing endpoint_id, name, adb_entity, the full Android serial and allowed contact IDs/labels. The app must already be provisioned. Do not include SIP credentials or Home Assistant tokens.

error.invalid_configuration: Enter a valid, credential-free endpoint JSON object with unique allowed contacts.

abort.already_configured: This Show SIP endpoint is already configured.
abort.duplicate_endpoint: Another Show SIP endpoint already uses this Android device or ADB entity.
abort.endpoint_id_in_use: This endpoint ID already has a different binding. Review the existing integration instead of replacing it through setup.
abort.invalid_configuration: The private Show SIP endpoint configuration is invalid.
